scope: Read-only inspection of preserved rejected v4 generated source, TTGIR and PTX. No GPU execution, compilation, source edits, new fixtures or threshold changes.

finding.operation: masked-loop sum of unrounded probabilities feeding l_i
finding.dataflow: Instrumented reduction %136 feeds denominator %l_i_318; line639 carries it out of the masked loop, line647 converts it back to MMA layout, and the later denominator feeds final log2 LSE at918-919.

instrumented_ptx.arithmetic: 63 sequential add.f32 instructions sum all64 values in one thread, store that sum, then feed it to denominator FMA.

finding.instrumented_source_location: PTX attributes this reduction to generated source line452:99, the added sum_unrounded_probabilities_f32 store; the consuming denominator FMA is at457:24.
finding.full_block_loop: Its probability reduction remains MMA-layout in both programs (original TTGIR381-386; instrumented804-812).
finding.conclusion: Instrumentation changes a floating-point summation order that reaches LSE. This is an actual arithmetic lowering difference, not merely a scheduling or register-number difference.

bounded_correction_assessment.justified_target: Prevent the debug-only tl.sum(p,1) observation consumer from selecting/reusing a non-native reduction layout in the live denominator path.
bounded_correction_assessment.candidate_guard: If one narrowly scoped observer correction is pursued, require generated masked-loop reduction layout and PTX addition/shuffle structure to retain the original MMA arithmetic before attempting the unchanged complete raw/log2-LSE/natural-LSE/frozen-fixture gate.
bounded_correction_assessment.not_authorized_by_this_review: No variant sweep, replacement reduction, tolerance widening, or interpretation of rejected intermediate values as native execution.

limitations: The saved artifacts prove this denominator arithmetic perturbation, but do not establish that it is the unique cause of every observed LSE mismatch.
No valid native intermediate oracle is obtained from rejected v4. Raw BF16 agreement does not waive the complete LSE gate.
